source_export.use: coverage-frequency, media-priority, and later close-paraphrase screening only

taxonomy.subtopic: Stanford classification, intimal tear, and branch-vessel malperfusion

entries.learning_objective: Localize an ascending-aortic intimal tear as Stanford type A disease and connect propagation into branch vessels or the aortic root to pulse deficits, neurologic ischemia, aortic regurgitation, and pericardial tamponade.
entries.media_spec: Original CT-angiography-style aortic map showing an intimal flap, true and false lumens, ascending involvement, branch-vessel extension, and possible pericardial blood.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets aortic-dissection anatomy, classification, or malperfusion.

taxonomy.subtopic: Light criteria, transudates, exudates, and pseudoexudates after diuresis

entries.learning_objective: Classify pleural fluid with Light criteria and recognize that diuresed heart-failure effusions can be borderline pseudoexudates requiring serum–pleural albumin or protein gradients.
entries.media_spec: Original paired chest-radiograph meniscus schematic and serum-versus-pleural-fluid table with Light-criteria calculations.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft tests pleural-fluid classification or pseudoexudates.

taxonomy.subtopic: Diffuse alveolar damage, hyaline membranes, and reduced compliance

entries.learning_objective: Connect endothelial and epithelial injury in ARDS to protein-rich alveolar edema, hyaline membranes, shunt physiology, bilateral opacities, and low lung compliance.
entries.media_spec: Original alveolar-capillary injury diagram paired with a pressure-volume curve and bilateral air-space opacity schematic.
entries.distinctness_note: Prior neonatal RDS content does not cover adult diffuse alveolar damage or ARDS physiology.

taxonomy.subtopic: Retrograde blood supply and proximal-pole avascular necrosis

entries.learning_objective: Explain why a displaced scaphoid waist fracture threatens the proximal pole through disruption of retrograde dorsal carpal blood flow, especially when initial radiographs are occult.
entries.media_spec: Original wrist and scaphoid vascular map with fracture levels, snuffbox localization, and proximal-pole perfusion arrows.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets scaphoid anatomy, occult fracture imaging, or retrograde perfusion.

taxonomy.subtopic: Urease-positive organisms, alkaline urine, and struvite staghorn calculi

entries.learning_objective: Link recurrent urinary infection by urease-positive bacteria to alkaline urine, ammonium magnesium phosphate precipitation, and branching staghorn calculi.
entries.media_spec: Original collecting-system staghorn stone schematic plus urease-driven urine-pH and crystal pathway.
entries.distinctness_note: Batch 011 covered enteric calcium oxalate stones, not infection-related struvite stones.

taxonomy.subtopic: MYC translocation, starry-sky histology, and high proliferative fraction

entries.learning_objective: Recognize Burkitt lymphoma by a MYC–immunoglobulin translocation, near-100% proliferative fraction, and tingible-body macrophages producing starry-sky histology.
entries.media_spec: Original jaw-or-abdominal mass map paired with MYC translocation and starry-sky histology schematics.
entries.distinctness_note: EBV mononucleosis was covered, but no prior draft targets MYC-driven Burkitt lymphoma.

taxonomy.subtopic: PML–RARA differentiation arrest, DIC, and all-trans retinoic acid

entries.learning_objective: Connect t(15;17) PML–RARA fusion to promyelocyte differentiation arrest, Auer-rod-rich cells, consumptive coagulopathy, and differentiation therapy with all-trans retinoic acid.
entries.media_spec: Original marrow smear schematic with abnormal promyelocytes and Auer rods plus coagulation trends and PML–RARA pathway.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers acute leukemia genetics, DIC, or differentiation therapy.

taxonomy.subtopic: Beta-pleated fibrils, Congo red binding, and apple-green birefringence

entries.learning_objective: Identify extracellular amyloid by Congo-red positivity and apple-green birefringence and distinguish immunoglobulin light-chain amyloid from inflammation-associated serum amyloid A deposition.
entries.media_spec: Original renal or cardiac tissue schematic showing extracellular deposits under ordinary and polarized light plus precursor-protein pathways.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets systemic amyloid structure, staining, or precursor classification.

taxonomy.subtopic: Multiple ring forms, banana-shaped gametocytes, and microvascular sequestration

entries.learning_objective: Recognize falciparum malaria on smear and connect PfEMP1-mediated cytoadherence and sequestration of infected erythrocytes to severe cerebral and multiorgan disease.
entries.media_spec: Original thin-smear panel with multiple rings and crescent gametocytes plus capillary sequestration schematic.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers malaria morphology or sequestration pathophysiology.

taxonomy.subtopic: Hepatic bypass, serotonin metabolism, and right-sided valvular fibrosis

entries.learning_objective: Explain why gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors usually cause systemic carcinoid syndrome only after hepatic metastasis and link circulating serotonin to right-sided valvular plaque formation.
entries.media_spec: Original gut–portal–liver pathway paired with flushing, urinary 5-HIAA, and tricuspid/pulmonic plaque schematics.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets neuroendocrine tumor hormone physiology or carcinoid heart disease.

taxonomy.subtopic: Primary-cilium signaling, bilateral cysts, and intracranial aneurysms

entries.learning_objective: Connect PKD1/PKD2 dysfunction in primary cilia to progressive bilateral renal cysts and recognize associated hepatic cysts and intracranial berry aneurysms.
entries.media_spec: Original renal-ultrasound-style cystic kidneys plus tubular primary-cilium and circle-of-Willis aneurysm diagrams.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers inherited cystic kidney disease or ciliary signaling.

taxonomy.subtopic: Peripheral-zone origin and osteoblastic axial metastases

entries.learning_objective: Distinguish peripheral-zone prostatic adenocarcinoma from transition-zone benign hyperplasia and connect vertebral venous spread to osteoblastic axial skeletal metastases.
entries.media_spec: Original zonal prostate map and spine image schematic showing sclerotic metastases with an alkaline-phosphatase trend.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets prostate zonal anatomy or osteoblastic metastatic behavior.

taxonomy.subtopic: Dimorphic fungus, intracellular yeast, and macrophage dissemination

entries.learning_objective: Recognize Histoplasma as a dimorphic fungus acquired from bird- or bat-contaminated soil whose small budding yeasts survive within macrophages and disseminate in impaired cellular immunity.
entries.media_spec: Original environmental-to-lung pathway, macrophage histology panel, and reticuloendothelial dissemination map.
entries.distinctness_note: Aspergillus and tuberculosis were covered, but no prior draft targets Histoplasma.

taxonomy.subtopic: Charcot–Bouchard microaneurysms and deep-brain hemorrhage

entries.learning_objective: Link chronic hypertension to lipohyalinosis and Charcot–Bouchard microaneurysms in small penetrating arteries causing basal-ganglia, thalamic, pontine, or cerebellar hemorrhage.
entries.media_spec: Original noncontrast-CT-style basal-ganglia hemorrhage and penetrating-arteriole microaneurysm schematic.
entries.distinctness_note: Prior stroke drafts cover ischemic MCA localization, not hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage.

taxonomy.subtopic: Antimitochondrial antibodies and autoimmune small-duct destruction

entries.learning_objective: Recognize primary biliary cholangitis from cholestatic laboratory results, antimitochondrial antibodies, pruritus, and granulomatous destruction of intrahepatic small bile ducts.
entries.media_spec: Original intrahepatic bile-duct histology schematic with florid duct lesion plus cholestatic laboratory and antibody panel.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets autoimmune cholangiopathy or antimitochondrial antibodies.

taxonomy.subtopic: Parenchymal cysts, scolex, degeneration, and seizure-provoking inflammation

entries.learning_objective: Identify neurocysticercosis by cystic or ring-enhancing parenchymal lesions containing a scolex and explain why inflammatory degeneration commonly provokes seizures.
entries.media_spec: Original staged brain-imaging panel showing viable cyst, degenerating ring lesion, and calcified lesion with scolex.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers cestode CNS infection or lesion-stage imaging.

taxonomy.subtopic: Rigid pericardium, ventricular interdependence, and discordant respiratory pressures

entries.learning_objective: Differentiate constrictive pericarditis from restrictive cardiomyopathy by a rigid pericardial shell, prominent ventricular interdependence, pericardial knock, and discordant respiratory ventricular pressure changes.
entries.media_spec: Original calcified-pericardium image and simultaneous ventricular-pressure tracing across inspiration.
entries.distinctness_note: Tamponade was covered, but no prior draft targets chronic constrictive physiology.

taxonomy.subtopic: Filaggrin barrier dysfunction and type 2 immune inflammation

entries.learning_objective: Connect impaired epidermal barrier function, often involving filaggrin, to allergen penetration, type 2 cytokine signaling, pruritus, and age-dependent flexural eczema distribution.
entries.media_spec: Original epidermal-barrier cross-section with filaggrin deficiency and a pediatric-versus-adult distribution map.
entries.distinctness_note: Allergic contact dermatitis was covered, but no prior draft targets atopic barrier biology.

taxonomy.subtopic: Microsomal triglyceride-transfer protein deficiency and fat-soluble vitamin loss

entries.learning_objective: Link microsomal triglyceride-transfer protein deficiency to absent apoB-containing lipoproteins, fat malabsorption, acanthocytosis, and vitamin E–related neurologic dysfunction.
entries.media_spec: Original enterocyte chylomicron-assembly diagram paired with a peripheral smear showing acanthocytes and a vitamin-E pathway.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft covers apoB lipoprotein assembly or abetalipoproteinemia.

taxonomy.subtopic: Cystic-duct obstruction, gallbladder inflammation, and ultrasound findings

entries.learning_objective: Recognize acute calculous cholecystitis as persistent cystic-duct obstruction producing gallbladder-wall inflammation, sonographic Murphy sign, wall thickening, and pericholecystic fluid.
entries.media_spec: Original biliary-tree and right-upper-quadrant ultrasound schematic showing an impacted neck stone and inflammatory changes.
entries.distinctness_note: No prior draft targets gallstone obstruction or cholecystitis imaging.
